summary: Sasol Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K on September 30, 2026, submitted under the 1934 Act (File 001-31615) by the Johannesburg-based crude petroleum and natural gas registrant. The submission contains four documents, led by a single-page image attachment and header metadata; no substantive special-situations text is present. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, deal mechanics, or regulatory clock is disclosed. Watch for subsequent 6-K filings that may carry asset-sale, restructuring, or capital-return announcements, since this filing alone presents no arbitrage angle.
